records.author: Copilot
records.body:
Scaffold repository for GPT-BRG04 (PING BrandGuard™) with required manifest, configuration, and directory structure for the AskJamie Lens System.

## Files Added

- **`gpt_manifest.yaml`** - Project manifest with tagline, metadata, and link placeholders for ping.com, lens hub, Notion spec, ChatGPT Project, and Custom GPT
- **`.gitignore`** - Standard exclusions for build artifacts, dependencies, IDE/OS files
- **Directory structure** - Created `/src`, `/prompts`, `/eval`, `/build`, `/ops` with `.gitkeep` files

## Files Modified

- **`README.md`** - Enhanced with tagline, links section, and directory structure documentation

<!-- START COPILOT CODING AGENT SUFFIX -->



<!-- START COPILOT ORIGINAL PROMPT -->



<details>

<summary>Original prompt</summary>

> Create a new GitHub repo named AskJamie-GPT-BRG04 for “GPT-BRG04: PING — OKHP³ BrandGuard™”. Initialize README.md, .gitignore, gpt_manifest.yaml, and folders /src /prompts /eval /build /ops. README+manifest must include tagline “The fairway to brand control just opened. Your move.” and links to the provided ping.com, lens hub, Notion, ChatGPT Project, and Custom GPT.
> 


</details>

review_comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Replace placeholder manifest links with real URLs**

The manifest’s `links` section still contains placeholder strings instead of actual URLs. Any tooling or documentation that reads `gpt_manifest.yaml` to render navigation or validate project metadata will surface invalid links (e.g., users can’t click through, automated checks that expect URL patterns will fail). Since this commit claims to initialize the repository with required metadata, these placeholders should be replaced with the real URLs that were already documented in the prior README.
